scientific_note: A policy selected from observed exact duplicate partitions chose a four-feature probe requiring one duplicate. It preserved every validation optimum and limited maximum overhead to 3.6%, but captured only 0.50% branch reduction and remained 2.0% slower at median. Probe activation is rejected as a universal default-on PySTreeD policy. The external integration remains valuable as an opt-in high-redundancy mode, while further research should target the identification-tree objective where the quotient's exact-search gains are much larger.
